subject: Annual prepay plan — drawdown telemetry & VAT bucket mapping
messages:
From: Grace Lee <grace.lee@greenbox.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Initial ask: annual prepay invoicing cadence and drawdown telemetry

Hi Rafael and Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. We reworked our budget cadence and need to lock an annual prepay schedule with clear drawdown visibility. Specifically we want: 
- A monthly CSV feed with drawdown telemetry (timestamp, invoice id, token units consumed, cumulative drawdown) for our finance system
- A VAT bucket mapping so our tax team can reconcile country-by-country liability
- A simple PO friendly invoice cadence (monthly or quarterly) and sample invoice numbering to fit our ERP

Attached is our procurement intake form and PO template. Can you propose a minimal telemetry schema and confirm whether Redwood can produce country-level VAT tags on invoices?

PO: GBX-2026-4892

Thanks,
Grace
Grace Lee
Head of Finance Operations
GreenBox AI

Attachment: GreenBox_procurement_request.pdf
From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>
To: Grace Lee <grace.lee@greenbox.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial ask: annual prepay invoicing cadence and drawdown telemetry

Hi Grace,

Appreciate the clear ask and the PO. We can absolutely support a monthly drawdown feed and per-country VAT tagging. I attached a first-pass telemetry sample (redwood_drawdown_telemetry_v1.csv) with the columns we typically provide. Highlights: 
- We include per-request timestamp, model id, billing tokens, route id, invoice_reference, and country_tag when available
- For performance we can push either an SFTP drop or a secure Drive CSV; let us know your preference
- Invoice cadence: we recommend monthly invoicing with a monthly reconciliation statement. Quarterly is possible but increases reconciliation complexity for committed spend.

Quick clarifying questions: 
1) Do you need pre-authorization of individual withdrawals (manual approval) or automated monthly draws against the prepay balance?
2) For VAT, are you looking for gross VAT amounts by country on each invoice or a separate VAT breakdown report for bookkeeping?

Next steps I propose: 
- We send the telemetry sample and the VAT bucket template for your tax team to fill out (attached as vat_bucket_map.xlsx)
- Align on drawdown cadence and sign the acknowledgement (we can DocuSign)
- Kick off a 30 min run-through for your FP&A and tax contacts

I can be on a call Wednesday 2pm CET or Thursday 9am CET.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Lead, EMEA Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_drawdown_telemetry_v1.csv
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
To: Grace Lee <grace.lee@greenbox.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial ask: annual prepay invoicing cadence and drawdown telemetry

Hi Grace, Rafael,

Looping in Rishi from Tax & Billing to confirm VAT handling. A few notes from our side on VAT mapping and invoicing: 
- We can put country VAT tags on each line on the invoice and also export a separate VAT reconciliation CSV for your tax system. That file will include country_code, vat_rate, vat_amount, net_amount, and invoice_reference.
- Please fill out the attached vat_bucket_map.xlsx with the country codes you need mapped to your ledger buckets. We use ISO country codes.
- For EU customers we typically require a VAT registration number to validate zero-rated intra-EU B2B treatment. If you have VAT IDs per country, add them to the template.

Operational question: if you prefer monthly automated draws we will process them on the 5th business day of each month against the committed balance and produce an invoice with the draw details. If manual approval is required we will provide a pending-withdrawal report on the 1st to authorize.

Action items for GreenBox: fill vat_bucket_map.xlsx, confirm automated vs manual draw, confirm preferred telemetry delivery (SFTP vs Drive).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Billing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vat_bucket_map.xlsx
From: Grace Lee <grace.lee@greenbox.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Initial ask: annual prepay invoicing cadence and drawdown telemetry

Hi Kimberly, Rafael,

Thanks — we reviewed the template with procurement and tax. A few confirmations: 
- We prefer monthly automated draws on the 5th business day against the prepay. No manual approvals.
- Please include gross VAT on each invoice line and provide the separate VAT reconciliation CSV monthly.
- Telemetry delivery: Drive link is easiest for our accounting automation.
- PO: GBX-2026-4892 should be referenced on every invoice.

I attached a signed acknowledgement of the proposed telemetry schema and the completed vat_bucket_map.xlsx with our country VAT IDs.

On the call times you suggested, Wednesday 2pm CET works for our FP&A and tax team.

Best,
Grace
Grace Lee
Head of Finance Operations
GreenBox AI

Hi Grace,

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround and the completed VAT mapping. Confirming our plan and deliverables: 
1) Invoice cadence: monthly invoices on the 5th business day, referencing PO GBX-2026-4892.
2) Telemetry: monthly CSV push to the Drive folder (we will drop redwood_drawdown_YYYYMM.csv on the first business day for the prior month). The schema will match the sample; we will include invoice_reference and country_tag on each row.
3) VAT: we will produce a separate VAT reconciliation CSV and include country-level VAT lines on the invoices.
4) Draw process: automated draw against committed prepay. Finance will send a monthly settlement notice for each draw.

Attached is the signed acknowledgement from GreenBox (signed-map-ack.pdf) and the initial telemetry sample for July so you can validate ingestion end-to-end.

Action items and owners: 
- Rafael: schedule the Wednesday 14:00 CET call and share calendar invite (done).
- Kimberly: finalize invoice template with VAT line layout and sample invoice PDF for GreenBox ERP (by next Monday).
- Rishi: confirm VAT handling for intra-EU B2B zero-rate cases (by next Wednesday).
- Grace: validate July telemetry file and confirm receipt on Drive after the call.

If anything changes please flag in the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/contacts/GreenBox-DL-8973
